title: Common row skeleton shared by the nine ledgers
description: Seven required fields plus two optional trace fields (03 L29-43). The key field is named id except in runs (run_id), scratch (ql_tag) and sessions (session_id); each ledger schema adds its own key property. schema_version is one number shared by all nine ledgers; any field-table change bumps it (03 L41).

version.description: starts at 1; a new version of the same key is a new row (03 L36)

status.description: per-ledger values; validation is keyed on it (03 L37)

session_id.description: writing session; a bare terminal records cli (03 L40)

schema_version.description: row-format version shared by all ledgers (03 L41)

force_reason.description: required when gyb writes with --force (03 L43)

via.description: marks an automatically written row: session_end (hook release rows, actor = the session's role) or reclaim (rl reclaim --apply, actor gyb) (03 L43)
